_source: Uber Base, Figma Community file l2llhOXNz1bM4aoLKKb5qi, page 3:4200, frames Display/Heading/Label/Paragraph and their Mono twins
_how: Read off every TEXT node's fontName, fontSize, lineHeight and letterSpacing and deduplicated by style signature. Not scraped from base.uber.com: that page is a Zeroheight SPA and WebFetch returns only the shell.

_families.ui-and-body: Uber Move Text (Medium 500 for labels, Regular 400 for paragraphs)
_families._note: THREE families, not one. The uber-move-2-cufonfonts.zip download holds only UberMoveMedium.otf and UberMoveBold.otf, so it is missing the entire Text and Mono families as well as a Regular weight. Uber Move's own metadata reads 'This custom font has been licensed exclusively to Uber' (MCKL / Jeremy Mickel, 2018).

_theInsight: Leading is a function of ROLE, not of size. Label and Paragraph share every size (18/16/14/12) and differ only in line height: Label 24/20/16/16, Paragraph 28/24/20/20. A label does not wrap so it can be tight; body copy wraps so it needs air. A system with one line-height per size cannot express that, and site-factory had 13 sizes against 3 line-heights with no relationship between them.
_tracking: 0px everywhere EXCEPT Heading 20px, which carries 0.25px. One exception in the whole system.
